emails.subject: The Men Who Built This...
emails.body:
Brother,

Fourteen years.

That's how long we've been building what I'm about to put into your hands at WARRIORCon 6.

And there's something I want you to understand before we gather on December 2, 3, and 4.

I didn't build this alone.

In December of 2012, I made a simple invitation to five men.

Five men who were willing to tell the truth about their lives.

Five men who were willing to confront the reality of what was happening in their bodies, their marriages, their businesses, and their relationship with God.

Five men who were willing to do something different.

I had no idea what would happen next.

Five became ten.

Ten became fifty.

Fifty became hundreds.

Hundreds became thousands.

And over the next fourteen years, more than 91,000 men would be impacted by the work we now know as the Warrior Method.

But here's what I want you to see.

The Warrior Method wasn't built in a classroom.

It was built in the trenches.

Through marriages that were falling apart.

Businesses that were collapsing.

Men confronting addictions, betrayals, failures, and fears they had spent years hiding.

It was built through men who had everything the world told them they should want, yet knew something was still missing.

And through men who had lost almost everything and were fighting to find their way back.

Some of those men won.

Some of those men lost.

Some made decisions that changed everything.

Others resisted the truth until the consequences became impossible to ignore.

But through every battle, something was being revealed.

A pattern.

A process.

A way for a man to confront the truth, find clarity, make a decision, and move forward.

And then return.

Report.

Recalibrate.

And go again.

Over fourteen years, those patterns became principles.

Those principles became processes.

And those processes became the system we're going to work through together at WARRIORCon 6.

But there's another truth I want you to understand.

The greatest evidence of Warrior was never me.

It was the men.

The father who became present with his children.

The husband who fought for his marriage.

The entrepreneur who stopped hiding from the numbers and made the decision that saved his company.

The man who finally stopped running from God.

And the leaders who took what they learned, stepped beyond Warrior, and began impacting others.

That's the story that matters now.

Not how great Warrior was.

But what became possible because Warrior existed.

And that's why we're gathering one final time for WARRIORCon 6.

Not to celebrate the past.

Not to spend three days talking about what we accomplished.

But to take fourteen years of lessons, battles, breakthroughs, and refinements and put them into YOUR hands.

The Code.

The Core.

The Stack.

The 12 week Impossible Game.

And now, WARRIOR AI at the core of ONE PIVOT (Formally Warrior App).

Technology that allows us to take the depth of this work and make it available in ways we could never have imagined when those first five men gathered in 2012.

AND HERE'S WHERE YOU COME IN.

I don't know what battle you're fighting right now.

I don't know what you've been carrying.

I don't know what decisions are sitting in front of you.

But I know this.

You didn't purchase a ticket to WARRIORCon 6 because you needed three more days of information.

Somewhere inside you, there's something you know needs to change.

Something you need to confront.

Something you need to build.

Or something you need to become.

And over December 2, 3, and 4, we're going to give you the tools to take that on.

SO HERE'S MY QUESTION FOR YOU TODAY.

If the next fourteen years of your life were shaped by the decisions you make over the next twelve weeks, what would you need to confront right now?

Don't rush past that question.

Sit with it.

Because the work doesn't begin when the event starts.

It begins when you decide to tell the truth.

Brother, I'm looking forward to what we're about to do together.

14 years to build it.

Three days to put it in your hands.

Garrett J. White
Founder, Wake Up Warrior
Creator, One Pivot & Warrior Ai

P.S. WARRIORCon 6 is December 2–4, from 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern each day, completely virtual. Protect those three days. Find a quiet place where you can participate fully. We're not gathering to watch. We're gathering to work.

emails.subject: You Cannot Prepare for Every Storm…
emails.subject_full: (WC6) - You Cannot Prepare for Every Storm…
emails.body:
Brother,

You've already made the decision to join us for WARRIORCon 6.

Your ticket is secured.

And on December 2, 3, and 4, we're going to put fourteen years of the Warrior Method into your hands.

But there's something I want you to understand before we get there.

YOU HAVE NO IDEA WHAT'S COMING.

Neither do I.

And neither do the hundreds of men who will be gathering with us.

Let me tell you a story.

There was a man who spent years doing the work inside Warrior.

Stacking.

Confronting the truth.

Building his relationship with God.

Working on his marriage.

Learning how to lead his family.

Day after day.

Week after week.

Year after year.

Not because everything in his life was falling apart.

But because he had made the decision to become the kind of man who could lead himself and the people he loved.

And then one day, everything changed.

HE DISCOVERED SOMETHING ABOUT HIS FAMILY THAT SHATTERED HIS WORLD.

For years, serious sexual abuse had been happening within his extended family.

People he loved had been carrying pain he knew nothing about.

And the person responsible was another member of the family.

He had no idea.

No warning.

No preparation for the specific nightmare that was about to confront him.

And suddenly, he was standing in the middle of a situation that no husband, father, or man ever wants to face.

The shock.

The anger.

The grief.

The questions.

The overwhelming weight of realizing that something terrible had been happening while he had been completely unaware.

And now he had to decide how to respond.

How to protect.

How to lead.

How to support the people who had been hurt.

How to face the truth without running from it.

HERE'S WHAT MAKES THIS STORY SO POWERFUL.

It wasn't the work he started doing after the crisis that gave him a foundation.

It was the work he had been doing for years before he ever knew the crisis was coming.

The daily Stacks.

The conversations.

The willingness to confront uncomfortable truths.

The relationship with God.

The discipline of returning, reporting, and recalibrating.

None of those things could have prevented what had happened.

And none of them could erase the pain.

But they had helped him develop the capacity to face a reality he never imagined he would encounter.

HE HAD BEEN PREPARING FOR A BATTLE HE DIDN'T KNOW WAS COMING.

And brother, this is one of the greatest lessons I've learned through fourteen years of working with men.

We spend so much of our lives preparing for the things we can see.

The next business deal.

The next financial target.

The next vacation.

The next opportunity.

The next milestone.

But what about the things we cannot see?

The diagnosis.

The betrayal.

The financial collapse.

The marriage crisis.

The conversation with a child that changes everything.

The phone call that turns your world upside down.

YOU CANNOT PREDICT EVERY STORM.

But you can build the capacity to face whatever comes.

Think about a farmer.

He doesn't plant his seeds the day he needs the harvest.

He plants them long before.

He works the soil.

He waters.

He protects.

He waits.

And he keeps doing the work even when there is nothing visible above the ground.

Because he understands something.

THE HARVEST IS DETERMINED BY THE WORK DONE BEFORE THE HARVEST IS NEEDED.

The same is true for a man.

Your daily decisions are planting something.

Your habits are planting something.

Your conversations with your wife are planting something.

Your relationship with God is planting something.

The way you lead your children is planting something.

And the way you confront the truth is planting something.

The question is not whether you're planting.

THE QUESTION IS WHAT YOU'RE GROWING.

AND THIS IS EXACTLY WHAT WE'RE GOING TO TAKE ON AT WARRIORCON 6.

You've already secured your ticket.

Now I want you to understand what we're going to do with those three days.

On December 2, 3, and 4, we're going to take you through a process that begins with the facts of your current reality.

Not the life you wish you were living.

Not the version of yourself you present to the world.

The actual results you're producing right now.

In your Body.

Your Being.

Your Balance.

Your Business.

Using the Code, the Core, and the Stack, we're going to help you identify the patterns that are creating those results.

And with WARRIOR AI inside ONE PIVOT, you'll have technology to guide you through the process as you work.

But we're not stopping with identifying problems.

WE'RE GOING TO BUILD YOUR NEXT 12-WEEK IMPOSSIBLE GAME.

A clear target.

A defined direction.

The decisions required to move forward.

And the daily actions that begin building the capacity you'll need for whatever comes next.

Because I don't want you leaving WARRIORCon 6 with another notebook full of ideas.

I want you leaving with a game you can actually execute.

And I want you to understand why this matters.

That man I told you about?

He didn't know the battle that was coming.

But he had spent years building the foundation he would need to face it.

And the same principle applies to you.

We cannot promise that your next twelve weeks will be easy.

We cannot predict the challenges you'll face.

But we can help you build a system for confronting reality, making decisions, taking action, and recalibrating when life changes.

THAT IS WHAT YOUR WARRIORCON 6 TICKET IS GOING TO PUT INTO YOUR HANDS.

SO HERE'S YOUR PREPARATION CHALLENGE FOR TODAY.

Before December 2, I want you to examine one question.

What am I failing to build today that I may desperately need tomorrow?

Maybe it's your physical health.

Maybe it's your relationship with your wife.

Maybe it's the trust of your children.

Maybe it's the financial stability of your business.

Maybe it's your relationship with God.

Maybe it's simply the ability to tell the truth when the truth is painful.

Don't try to fix everything today.

Identify ONE area.

And take ONE action to strengthen it.

Then bring that area of your life with you to WARRIORCon 6.

Because when we begin working through the Code, the Core, and the Stack, you'll already have a real situation to examine.

And when we begin building your 12-week Impossible Game, you'll have a meaningful direction to explore.

You cannot prepare for every storm.

But you can prepare the man who will have to stand in it.

I'll see you December 2.

14 years to build it.

Three days to put it in your hands.

Garrett J. White
Founder, Wake Up Warrior
Creator, ONE PIVOT & WARRIOR AI

P.S. WARRIORCon 6 is December 2–4, from 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern each day. This is a virtual, hands-on working experience. Protect your calendar, prepare a quiet workspace, and make sure you have WARRIOR AI access inside ONE PIVOT before we begin.

emails.subject: This Is No Longer About Me…
emails.subject_full: (WC6) - This Is No Longer About Me…
emails.body:
Brother,

For fourteen years, my face, my voice, my story, and my life have been at the center of Wake Up Warrior.

The man who lost millions.

The man who nearly destroyed his marriage.

The man who fought his way back.

The man who built Warrior.

The man who stood on stages, led thousands of men, and challenged them to confront the truth about their lives.

For years, that story was the invitation.

And it worked.

More than 91,000 men have been impacted by the Warrior Method since 2012.

But somewhere along the way, something became clear to me.

THE GREATEST STORY WAS NEVER MINE.

It was theirs.

The men who took what they learned and did something with it.

The men who walked out of Warrior Week and went home to face conversations they had been avoiding for years.

The men who stopped blaming their wives and started leading their marriages.

The men who stopped pretending their businesses were fine and finally confronted the numbers.

The men who rebuilt relationships with their children.

The men who found their way back to God.

The men who broke patterns that had controlled their families for generations.

And the men who took the Warrior Method beyond the walls of our organization and began leading others.

THESE MEN BECAME THE EVIDENCE.

But I want to take this one step further.

Because there is a fundamental difference between building a movement around one man...

...and building a system that thousands of men can take into their own lives and use without that man being present.

For fourteen years, I have been the central voice of Warrior.

The one teaching the frameworks.

The one leading the events.

The one challenging the men.

The one carrying the message.

And while that produced extraordinary results, it also created a limitation.

AS LONG AS THE SYSTEM DEPENDS ON ME, THE IMPACT IS LIMITED BY ME.

My time.

My energy.

My availability.

My ability to be in the room.

And brother, after fourteen years, I no longer believe that's how this is supposed to work.

THE NEXT CHAPTER IS NOT ABOUT BUILDING A BIGGER WARRIOR.

It's about what becomes possible because Warrior existed.

Let me show you what I mean.

A father takes the Code into his home.

Instead of reacting to his teenage son with anger, he separates the facts from his feelings, finds his focus, and chooses a different response.

His son experiences a different father.

A husband takes the Stack into his marriage.

Instead of avoiding the conversation he's terrified to have, he confronts the truth, gets clear on what he wants, and sits down with his wife.

His marriage has an opportunity to move in a different direction.

A founder takes the Impossible Game into his company.

Instead of running another year of scattered goals, he establishes a 12-week target, aligns his leadership team, and begins returning and reporting on what actually gets done.

His company begins operating differently.

A pastor takes the principles into his ministry.

Instead of simply delivering another message on Sunday, he begins helping the men in his congregation confront their lives and take action throughout the week.

His community begins changing.

AND NONE OF THOSE MEN NEED ME STANDING NEXT TO THEM.

That's the point.

That's what WE means.

Not a bigger audience watching Garrett.

Not more men dependent on another Warrior event.

Not another program where transformation only happens when someone is being pushed by a coach.

WE MEANS THE TOOLS ARE IN THE HANDS OF THE MEN WHO WILL USE THEM.

Men who can lead themselves.

Men who can confront their own reality.

Men who can make decisions.

Men who can return, report, recalibrate, and move forward.

And men who can take what they've learned and help others do the same.

That's the future I see.

And that's why WARRIORCon 6 matters.

YOU'VE ALREADY MADE THE DECISION TO BE PART OF THIS.

Your ticket is secured.

You've committed December 2, 3, and 4 to the experience.

And during those three days, we're going to work through the system together.

The Code.

The Core.

The Stack.

The 12-week Impossible Game.

And WARRIOR AI inside ONE PIVOT.

But here's what I want you to understand.

I DON'T WANT YOU TO LEAVE NEEDING ANOTHER EVENT WITH ME.

I want you to leave knowing how to use the system yourself.

When you're sitting in your office facing a difficult business decision.

When you're standing in your kitchen after an argument with your wife.

When you're struggling with your body, your faith, or your focus.

When your team needs direction.

When the game you established isn't producing the results you expected.

You'll have a process you can return to.

A way to confront the facts.

A way to find clarity.

A way to make a decision.

And a way to move forward.

With WARRIOR AI available to help guide you through the work.

THAT IS WHAT WE'RE BUILDING TOWARD ON DECEMBER 2, 3, AND 4.

Not dependence.

Ownership.

Not another moment of inspiration.

A system you can operate.

Not another fourteen years of watching what I build.

The beginning of what YOU build with what we've learned.

And there's something else.

When you begin operating differently, the impact doesn't stop with you.

Your wife experiences a different husband.

Your children experience a different father.

Your employees experience a different leader.

Your clients experience a different business owner.

And the people you influence begin experiencing something different because you made a decision to change.

That's how the impact expands.

Not because one man stands on a bigger stage.

But because thousands of men begin leading differently wherever God has placed them.

SO HERE'S YOUR PREPARATION CHALLENGE FOR TODAY.

Before December 2, I want you to answer two questions.

1. Where in my life am I still depending on someone else to push me, motivate me, or tell me what to do?

2. What would change if I took full ownership of leading myself in that area?

Write down your answers.

Then identify ONE place where you can begin taking ownership today.

Bring that situation with you to WARRIORCon 6.

Because when we begin working with the Code, the Core, the Stack, and WARRIOR AI, I want you applying those tools to a real situation in your life.

And when we build your next 12-week Impossible Game, I want it to be something YOU own.

Something YOU can execute.

Something YOU can return and report on.

Long after December 4.

Brother, this is no longer about me.

THIS IS ABOUT WE.

The men who helped build the system.

The men who proved what was possible.

And the men who will now take it into their homes, businesses, families, churches, and communities.

Including you.

I'll see you December 2.

14 years to build it.

Three days to put it in your hands.

Garrett J. White
Founder, Wake Up Warrior
Creator, ONE PIVOT & WARRIOR AI

P.S. WARRIORCon 6 is December 2–4, from 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern each day. This is a virtual, hands-on working experience. Protect your calendar, prepare a quiet workspace, and make sure you have access to WARRIOR AI inside ONE PIVOT before we begin.

emails.subject: The Most Dangerous Lie a Man Tells…
emails.subject_full: (WC6) - The Most Dangerous Lie a Man Tells…
emails.body:
Brother,

There is a lie I've watched destroy more men than almost anything else over the last fourteen years.

And it's not the lie a man tells his wife.

It's not the lie he tells his employees.

It's not even the lie he tells his children.

IT'S THE LIE HE TELLS HIMSELF.

The lie that says...

"I'm fine."

"My marriage is good."

"My business is under control."

"I'll get my body back when things slow down."

"I'll spend more time with my kids when this next deal closes."

"I know what I need to do."

And perhaps the most dangerous lie of all...

"I'LL DEAL WITH IT LATER."

Brother, I've sat across from thousands of men who were incredibly successful at convincing the world they had everything under control.

They had the money.

The businesses.

The homes.

The cars.

The families.

The titles.

And the appearance of a life that everyone else wanted.

But behind closed doors?

Their marriages were disconnected.

Their children barely knew them.

Their bodies were breaking down.

Their businesses were consuming every waking hour.

And their relationship with God had become something they talked about more than something they actually lived.

Yet when you asked them how things were going?

"I'm good."

NO. YOU'RE NOT.

And somewhere deep inside, they knew it.

But admitting the truth would require them to confront something they had spent years avoiding.

Because once a man tells the truth, he can no longer pretend he doesn't know.

And once he knows?

HE HAS A DECISION TO MAKE.

This is why the very first foundation of the Warrior Method was never motivation.

It wasn't goal setting.

It wasn't positive thinking.

And it wasn't another strategy for making more money.

IT WAS THE TRUTH.

In 2012, when I began working with the first five men who would become the foundation of Warrior, I discovered something that would shape everything we built.

Men are capable of lying to themselves while genuinely believing they're telling the truth.

Not always because they're intentionally dishonest.

But because they've become so attached to their explanations, excuses, and stories that they can no longer separate what happened from what they believe happened.

And that's where the Code was born.

FACTS.

What actually happened?

Not your interpretation.

Not your justification.

Not your explanation.

What are the facts?

FEELINGS.

What are you actually feeling about those facts?

Anger?

Fear?

Shame?

Resentment?

Disappointment?

What emotions are you carrying that you've refused to acknowledge?

FOCUS.

What are you choosing to focus on?

The problem?

The person you blame?

The circumstances you cannot control?

Or the decision you have the power to make?

FRUIT.

What are your current actions producing?

Not what you intended.

Not what you hoped.

What is actually happening in your life?

Brother, these four distinctions have become foundational to everything we teach.

Because you cannot change what you're unwilling to confront.

And you cannot confront what you refuse to see.

NOW LET ME CONNECT THIS DIRECTLY TO WARRIORCON 6.

You've already purchased your ticket.

You've committed December 2, 3, and 4 to this experience.

And during those three days, we're going to take the Code, the Core, the Stack, and WARRIOR AI and put them to work on your actual life.

Not some hypothetical example.

Not another man's problems.

YOURS.

We're going to examine what's happening in your Body, Being, Balance, and Business.

We're going to use the tools to separate the facts from the stories you've been telling yourself.

We're going to confront the patterns that have been producing your current results.

And we're going to use that clarity to help you build your next 12-week Impossible Game.

But there's something I need you to understand.

WARRIOR AI CANNOT TELL THE TRUTH FOR YOU.

It can ask you questions.

It can help you organize your thoughts.

It can guide you through the Stack.

It can help you see patterns and explore possibilities.

But it cannot make you be honest.

That's a decision only you can make.

And if you walk into WARRIORCon 6 committed to protecting the stories you've been telling yourself, you can spend three days working with the most refined version of the Warrior Method we've ever built...

...and still walk away protecting the very patterns that have been holding you back.

I DON'T WANT THAT FOR YOU.

I want you to arrive ready to confront reality.

Not to beat yourself up.

Not to drown in guilt or shame.

But to finally get clear about where you are so you can decide where you're going.

SO HERE'S YOUR PREPARATION CHALLENGE FOR TODAY.

I want you to choose ONE area of your life.

Your Body.

Your Being.

Your Balance.

Or your Business.

And answer these four questions.

FACTS: What is actually happening in this area of my life right now?

FEELINGS: What am I feeling about those facts that I haven't fully acknowledged?

FOCUS: What story, excuse, or distraction have I been using to avoid confronting the truth?

RESULTS: What have my current decisions and actions actually produced?

Write down your answers.

Don't edit them to make yourself look better.

Don't try to solve everything.

Just tell the truth.

And bring those answers with you to WARRIORCon 6.

Because when we begin working through the Code and the Stack, you'll already have a real situation to put through the process.

And when we begin building your 12-week Impossible Game, you'll have a clearer understanding of what needs to change.

THE MOST DANGEROUS LIE A MAN TELLS IS THE ONE THAT ALLOWS HIM TO KEEP LIVING A LIFE HE KNOWS ISN'T WORKING.

But the moment he tells the truth?

He creates the possibility of a different future.

Brother, you've already made the decision to join us.

Now make the decision to arrive ready.

I'll see you on December 2.

14 years to build it.

Three days to put it in your hands.

Garrett J. White
Founder, Wake Up Warrior
Creator, ONE PIVOT & WARRIOR AI

P.S. WARRIORCon 6 is December 2–4, from 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern each day. This is a virtual, hands-on working experience. Protect your calendar, prepare a quiet workspace, and make sure you have access to WARRIOR AI inside ONE PIVOT before we begin.

emails.subject: Your Results Are Telling a Story…
emails.subject_full: (WC6) - Your Results Are Telling a Story…
emails.body:
Brother,

There is something I've learned after fourteen years of working with men.

YOUR RESULTS DON'T CARE ABOUT YOUR EXCUSES.

They don't care about your intentions.

They don't care about how hard you've been working.

They don't care about how much money you've made.

And they certainly don't care about the story you've been telling yourself about why things are the way they are.

Your results simply reveal what is happening.

And whether you like what they reveal or not...

THEY ARE TELLING A STORY.

Let me explain.

I've worked with men running companies doing tens of millions of dollars a year.

Men responsible for hundreds of employees.

Men with enormous financial responsibilities.

Men who could walk into a boardroom and command the attention of everyone sitting at the table.

But when we began examining their lives, something interesting happened.

The man who could tell you every financial metric in his company couldn't tell you the last time he had a meaningful conversation with his wife.

The man who could lead hundreds of employees couldn't remember the last time he had been fully present with his children.

The man who had built an extraordinary business was physically exhausted, overweight, and running on caffeine and adrenaline.

And the man who spoke confidently about his faith hadn't spent meaningful time alone with God in months.

SUCCESS IN ONE AREA HAD BECOME THE COVER STORY FOR FAILURE IN ANOTHER.

And here's the dangerous part.

The world was applauding him.

His employees admired him.

His clients respected him.

His bank account validated him.

But his life was telling a very different story.

And brother, this is exactly why we built the Core Four.

Because a man is not simply a business.

He's not simply a body.

He's not simply a husband or father.

And he's not simply a spiritual being.

HE IS ALL FOUR.

BODY.

BEING.

BALANCE.

BUSINESS.

Four critical areas of a man's life.

Four arenas where his decisions produce results.

And four places where the truth eventually becomes impossible to ignore.

LET'S LOOK AT EACH ONE.

BODY.

Your physical health.

Your strength.

Your energy.

Your discipline.

Your ability to operate physically at the level your life demands.

You can tell yourself you're healthy.

But what do your habits reveal?

What does your energy reveal?

What does your physical condition reveal?

BEING.

Your relationship with God.

Your spiritual life.

Your connection to truth.

Your willingness to be still, listen, pray, and surrender.

You can tell yourself God is first.

But what does your daily calendar reveal?

What do your private decisions reveal?

What happens when nobody is watching?

BALANCE.

Your marriage.

Your children.

Your relationships.

The people who experience you when the business day ends.

You can tell yourself your family is your highest priority.

But what does your presence reveal?

What do your conversations reveal?

What would your wife or children say about the man they actually experience?

BUSINESS.

Your money.

Your mission.

Your leadership.

Your ability to create, produce, and provide.

You can tell yourself you're building something extraordinary.

But what do the numbers reveal?

What does your cash flow reveal?

What does your team reveal?

What does the amount of freedom you actually have reveal?

HERE'S THE TRUTH.

You can be winning in one area while quietly losing in another.

And if you continue ignoring the areas where you're losing, eventually those consequences can begin affecting everything else you've built.

I've watched it happen.

A marriage crisis destroys a man's focus in business.

A health crisis forces a successful founder to confront years of neglect.

A financial collapse exposes the cost of avoiding difficult decisions.

A spiritual crisis leaves a man questioning the very life he's spent decades building.

THE FOUR ARE CONNECTED.

And this is why the Warrior Method was never simply about making more money.

It was about helping a man confront the entirety of his life.

Not just the parts he was proud to show the world.

NOW HERE'S WHY THIS MATTERS FOR YOUR WARRIORCON 6 EXPERIENCE.

You've already purchased your ticket.

You've committed December 2, 3, and 4 to doing the work.

And during those three days, we're going to take the Core Four and use it to examine your actual results.

Not your intentions.

Not your explanations.

YOUR RESULTS.

We'll use the Code to confront the facts.

The Stack to work through the patterns, feelings, and decisions connected to those facts.

And WARRIOR AI inside ONE PIVOT to help guide the process.

Then we'll take what you've uncovered and begin building your next 12-week Impossible Game.

But here's where I want you to pay attention.

YOUR NEXT 12-WEEK GAME CANNOT BE BUILT ON A FALSE PICTURE OF YOUR CURRENT LIFE.

If you pretend your marriage is fine when it's not, you'll build the wrong game.

If you pretend your business is healthy when the numbers say otherwise, you'll establish the wrong targets.

If you ignore your physical condition because you're making money, you'll continue paying a price.

And if you claim God is first while giving Him whatever time is left over, you'll be building on a contradiction.

The starting point matters.

Because the quality of your next decision depends on your willingness to confront your current reality.

SO HERE'S YOUR PREPARATION CHALLENGE FOR TODAY.

Before December 2, I want you to take an honest inventory of your Core Four.

Not a complicated exercise.

Just four questions.

BODY: What are my current physical results telling me about how I've been treating my body?

BEING: What does my daily relationship with God actually look like?

BALANCE: What are my marriage, family, and relationships experiencing because of how I'm currently living?

BUSINESS: What do my actual financial, leadership, and operational results reveal about the company or career I'm building?

Write down your answers.

Then ask yourself one more question.

WHICH OF THESE FOUR AREAS HAVE I BEEN USING SUCCESS IN ANOTHER AREA TO AVOID CONFRONTING?

That's the question I really want you to sit with.

Because you may discover that the area you've been celebrating has been distracting you from the area that most desperately needs your attention.

Bring that truth with you to WARRIORCon 6.

When we begin working through the Core Four, you'll already have a starting point.

And when we begin building your 12-week Impossible Game, you'll be better prepared to choose targets that actually matter.

Brother, the goal is not to have a perfect life.

The goal is to stop pretending that success in one area excuses neglect in another.

YOUR RESULTS ARE TELLING A STORY.

The question is whether you're willing to listen.

The decisions that brought you here.

The habits.

But others?

A founder builds a multimillion-dollar company through sheer force of will.

He works harder than everyone.

Makes every decision.

Carries every problem.

And eventually becomes the greatest limitation inside the company he created.

A husband spends years believing his responsibility is to provide financially.

And he does.

But somewhere along the way, he becomes a stranger to the wife and children he's working so hard to support.

A man builds his entire identity around being strong.

Never needing help.

Never showing weakness.

Never admitting fear.

Until the day life delivers something his strength alone cannot carry.

WHAT ONCE MADE HIM SUCCESSFUL HAS BECOME WHAT KEEPS HIM STUCK.

And here's where things get difficult.

Because changing your strategy is one thing.

CHANGING THE MAN WHO KEEPS CHOOSING THAT STRATEGY IS SOMETHING ELSE ENTIRELY.

It's easy to say you want a different business.

A stronger marriage.

A healthier body.

A deeper relationship with God.

The identity of the man who has all the answers.

The man who never slows down.

The man who doesn't need anyone.

The man who measures his worth by how much he produces.

The man who has to be right.

THAT'S WHERE THE REAL WORK BEGINS.

I could lead men.

Build companies.

Create systems.

Produce extraordinary results.

And still find myself confronting patterns in my marriage, my family, and my relationship with God that required something different from me.

Not another business strategy.

Not another target.

Because the goal was never simply to help a man accomplish more.

But with becoming willing to recognize that the next chapter may require something new from you.

A different level of honesty.

A different kind of leadership.

A different relationship with your wife.

A different commitment to your body.

A different willingness to listen to God.

YOUR IMPOSSIBLE GAME ISN'T JUST ABOUT WHAT YOU'RE GOING TO ACCOMPLISH.

IT'S ABOUT WHO YOU MUST BECOME TO ACCOMPLISH IT.

Because a target without transformation often becomes another cycle of effort followed by disappointment.

But when a man begins changing the way he sees, decides, and operates?

The possibilities expand.

The founder begins building leaders instead of creating dependency.

The husband begins creating connection instead of simply providing money.

And the man who has spent years trying to control everything begins learning how to trust God.

THE GAME CHANGES BECAUSE THE MAN CHANGES.

SO HERE'S YOUR PREPARATION CHALLENGE FOR TODAY.

I want you to consider one question.

WHAT PART OF THE MAN I'VE BEEN MUST CHANGE FOR THE FUTURE I WANT TO BECOME POSSIBLE?

Maybe it's your addiction to being busy.

Maybe it's your attachment to an identity that no longer serves the life you're trying to build.

emails.subject: The People Who Pay for Your Decisions…

emails.body:
Brother,

There's something I've learned over the last fourteen years of working with men that I wish I had understood much earlier in my own life.

YOU ARE NOT THE ONLY PERSON LIVING WITH THE CONSEQUENCES OF YOUR DECISIONS.

Your wife lives with them.

Your children live with them.

Your employees live with them.

And the people who depend on your leadership experience the results of decisions they never got to make.

Think about that for a moment.

A man decides to work another twelve-hour day.

To him, it's just another day at the office.

To his wife, it might be another evening alone.

To his children, another dinner without Dad.

A founder avoids confronting a problem inside his company.

To him, he's buying time.

To his employees, that decision may eventually determine whether they can pay their mortgages.

A husband refuses to have a difficult conversation.

To him, he's keeping the peace.

To his wife, he's creating another layer of distance.

ONE MAN. ONE DECISION. MULTIPLE LIVES IMPACTED.

Brother, I know this because I've lived it.

There have been seasons when I convinced myself that because I was building something important, the sacrifices everyone else was making were justified.

I was building Warrior.

Providing for my family.

Leading men.

Creating opportunities.

And much of that work mattered.

But there were also moments when I had to confront an uncomfortable truth.

MY INTENTIONS DIDN'T CANCEL OUT THE IMPACT OF MY DECISIONS.

I could love my wife and still make decisions that created distance.

I could love my children and still be absent from moments that mattered.

I could care deeply about my team and still create unnecessary pressure through the way I operated.

And no amount of success could erase those realities.

That's a difficult thing for a man to admit.

Especially when he's spent years believing he's doing everything for the people he loves.

But here's what I've come to understand.

LEADERSHIP ISN'T MEASURED ONLY BY WHAT YOU BUILD.

IT'S ALSO REVEALED IN WHAT HAPPENS TO THE PEOPLE BUILDING LIFE WITH YOU.

And this is where the conversation changes.

Because once you recognize that your decisions impact other people, your future stops being just a personal ambition.

Your health matters because your family needs you alive, strong, and present.

Your marriage matters because the relationship you build becomes part of the environment your children grow up in.

Your business matters because the way you lead affects the lives and livelihoods of others.

Your relationship with God matters because what guides you privately eventually shapes how you lead publicly.

YOUR LIFE IS CONNECTED TO MORE PEOPLE THAN YOU REALIZE.

And that's not meant to create guilt.

It's meant to reveal possibility.

Because if your decisions can create consequences for the people around you...

THEY CAN ALSO CREATE FREEDOM.

One honest conversation can begin rebuilding trust.

One decision to change how you lead can create opportunity for your team.

One commitment to your health can change how you show up for your family.

One moment of surrender before God can change the direction of an entire season.

Brother, that's the kind of possibility I want you considering as we prepare for WARRIORCon 6.

You've already secured your ticket for December 2, 3, and 4.

And during those three days, we're going to use the Warrior Method and WARRIOR AI inside ONE PIVOT to help you build your next 12-week Impossible Game.

THIS GAME IS BIGGER THAN YOUR PERSONAL GOALS.

Yes, we'll establish targets.

Yes, we'll confront your current results across Body, Being, Balance, and Business.

Yes, we'll use the Code and the Stack to clarify what's happening and what needs to change.

But I don't want you leaving with another list of things you want to accomplish.

I want you leaving with a clear understanding of what becomes possible for the people connected to your life when you begin making different decisions.

Because the real power of a 12-week Impossible Game isn't just what changes for you.

IT'S WHAT YOUR TRANSFORMATION MAKES POSSIBLE FOR OTHERS.

A wife who begins experiencing a different husband.

Children who begin experiencing a more present father.

Employees who begin experiencing a different kind of leader.

A community that benefits from a man operating with greater clarity and conviction.

And perhaps most importantly...

A man who no longer has to carry the burden of pretending his decisions affect only himself.

SO HERE'S YOUR PREPARATION CHALLENGE FOR TODAY.

I want you to identify three people who are directly impacted by the way you're currently living and leading.

Your wife.

One of your children.

A business partner or employee.

Whoever comes to mind.

Then ask yourself three questions.

1. What are these people currently experiencing because of the decisions I'm making?

2. What might they be experiencing that I haven't been willing to acknowledge?

3. What could become possible for them if I changed ONE significant pattern over the next twelve weeks?

Don't rush through those questions.

And don't answer them only from your perspective.

If appropriate, have a conversation with one of those people.

Ask them what they're actually experiencing.

Then listen.

Not to defend yourself.

Not to explain your intentions.

TO UNDERSTAND THE IMPACT.

Bring what you discover to WARRIORCon 6.

Because when we begin building your next 12-week Impossible Game, I want you thinking beyond the targets you're trying to hit.

I want you thinking about the people who will live with the results.

Brother, you have more influence than you realize.

And that influence carries responsibility.

But it also carries extraordinary possibility.

THE PEOPLE AROUND YOU ARE ALREADY EXPERIENCING THE RESULTS OF YOUR DECISIONS.

IMAGINE WHAT BECOMES POSSIBLE WHEN THOSE DECISIONS BEGIN TO CHANGE.

And in many ways, he was.

But there was another story unfolding behind the scenes.

HIS BUSINESS WAS GROWING.

HIS MARRIAGE WAS BREAKING.

He and his wife were building the company together.

They had five children in their blended family.

And as the business accelerated, so did the pressure inside their home.

More responsibility.

More decisions.

More expectations.

Less connection.

Until the very thing they were building to create freedom was beginning to threaten the relationship they were building it for.

Brother, I've seen this pattern more times than I can count.

And I've lived versions of it myself.

We tell ourselves we're building the business for our families.

For freedom.

For opportunity.

For the future.

But somewhere along the way, the business begins demanding everything.

And the people we love most begin receiving whatever is left.

THAT'S NOT FREEDOM.

THAT'S A DIFFERENT KIND OF PRISON.

Now here's what made this man's situation interesting.

He didn't need someone to teach him how to make more money.

He had already proven he could do that.

He needed to confront a different question.

WHAT IS THE POINT OF BUILDING AN EXTRAORDINARY BUSINESS IF THE LIFE IT'S SUPPOSED TO SUPPORT IS FALLING APART?

That question changes the game.

Because suddenly the target isn't just more revenue.

It's not another expansion.

It's not another milestone.

It's becoming a man capable of leading a successful company without sacrificing the relationships that matter most.

And that requires a PIVOT.

Not necessarily selling the company.

Not abandoning ambition.

Not pretending the business doesn't matter.

But confronting the patterns that have allowed success in one area to create damage in another.

THE PROBLEM WASN'T THAT HE WAS BUILDING SOMETHING BIG.

THE PROBLEM WAS WHAT HIS WAY OF BUILDING WAS COSTING HIM.

And that's the moment where possibility begins.

Because when a man sees the pattern, he has a choice.

He can keep defending it.

Keep explaining why the pressure is necessary.

Keep promising his wife that things will change after the next milestone.

Or he can decide that the way he's been operating is no longer acceptable.

And begin making different decisions.

About his time.

His priorities.

His leadership.

His marriage.

His definition of success.

I won't pretend those decisions make everything easy.

A marriage doesn't rebuild overnight.

A business doesn't suddenly stop demanding attention.

But the direction of a man's life can change the moment he stops accepting the pattern that has been producing his results.

ONE DECISION CAN OPEN A FUTURE THAT WASN'T AVAILABLE UNDER THE OLD GAME.

And brother, that's what I want you thinking about as we prepare for WARRIORCon 6.

You've already made the decision to join us December 2–4.

And we're going to spend those three days putting the Warrior Method and WARRIOR AI inside ONE PIVOT to work on your actual life.

We'll use the Core Four to examine Body, Being, Balance, and Business.

The Code to confront the facts, feelings, focus, and results.

The Stack to uncover the patterns influencing your decisions.

And then we'll build your next 12-week Impossible Game.

But I want to challenge how you think about that game.

WHAT IF YOUR NEXT IMPOSSIBLE GAME ISN'T ABOUT ACHIEVING MORE?

What if it's about creating something you've never experienced?

A business that grows without consuming your life.

A marriage that becomes stronger while your responsibilities increase.

A relationship with your children that isn't built around whatever time remains.

A life where your faith isn't something you squeeze into the margins.

What if the next twelve weeks could become the beginning of a different way of living?

NOT SMALLER AMBITIONS.

A BIGGER DEFINITION OF SUCCESS.

HERE'S YOUR PREPARATION CHALLENGE FOR TODAY.

I want you to consider one question.

WHAT IS MY CURRENT VERSION OF SUCCESS COSTING ME THAT I'M NO LONGER WILLING TO PAY?

Maybe it's time with your family.

Maybe it's your health.

Maybe it's peace inside your marriage.

Maybe it's your relationship with God.

Maybe it's something nobody else knows about.

Write it down.

Then ask yourself:

IF I REFUSED TO KEEP PAYING THAT PRICE, WHAT WOULD I NEED TO CHANGE?

Don't worry about solving everything today.

Just tell yourself the truth.

And bring that answer with you to WARRIORCon 6.

Because when we build your next 12-week Impossible Game, I don't want you chasing another target that leaves you successful on paper and empty everywhere else.

I want you building something worth winning.

Brother, the future isn't determined only by what you're capable of accomplishing.

It's also shaped by what you're willing to change.

WHAT BECOMES POSSIBLE WHEN A MAN DECIDES?

Sometimes an entirely different life.

I'm looking forward to doing this work with you.

14 years to build it.

Three days to put it in your hands.

Garrett J. White
Founder, Wake Up Warrior

emails.subject: Your Next 12 Weeks…
emails.body:
Brother,

I want you to think about something for a moment.

Twelve weeks.

84 days.

That's it.

Not five years.

Not twelve months.

84 DAYS.

Now imagine that twelve weeks from today, you're sitting in a completely different reality.

Not because everything in your life magically changed.

But because you made a decision about what mattered most.

And then spent 84 days executing on it.

I've watched men change the direction of their lives in twelve weeks.

Men who had spent years talking about rebuilding their marriages finally began having the conversations they'd been avoiding.

Men who had allowed their businesses to consume their lives began creating teams and systems that gave them room to breathe.

Men who had neglected their bodies began rebuilding their strength.

Men who had been drifting spiritually began establishing a daily relationship with God that changed how they operated.

Not because twelve weeks is some magical number.

BECAUSE THEY STOPPED LIVING WITHOUT A CLEAR GAME.

Brother, here's what I've discovered.

Most men don't have a problem working hard.

They know how to work.

They know how to sacrifice.

They know how to push through difficult circumstances.

But ask them one question.

WHAT EXACTLY ARE YOU BUILDING OVER THE NEXT TWELVE WEEKS?

And suddenly things get quiet.

They have responsibilities.

They have obligations.

They have things they hope will improve.

But a clear target?

A defined outcome?

A process for executing daily and measuring progress weekly?

That's often missing.

And without it, life becomes a series of reactions.

The business needs something.

The family needs something.

Another problem shows up.

Another week disappears.

And before you know it, another three months have passed.

BUSY DOESN'T MEAN YOU'RE BUILDING.

That's why the 12-week Impossible Game has become such an important part of the Warrior Method.

It's not about writing down a list of things you want.

It's about deciding what you're willing to create.

And then organizing your life around making it happen.

ONE CLEAR GAME.

A TARGET THAT MATTERS.

A MAN WILLING TO EXECUTE.

But here's where it gets interesting.

The Impossible Game isn't simply about achieving an outcome.

It's about becoming the man capable of producing that outcome.

Because the man who starts the game and the man who finishes it shouldn't be operating the same way.

His decisions change.

His standards change.

His relationships change.

His capacity changes.

And the results begin reflecting those changes.

THE TARGET GIVES YOU DIRECTION.

THE GAME DEMANDS TRANSFORMATION.

And this is exactly what we're going to build together at WARRIORCon 6.

You've already secured your ticket for December 2, 3, and 4.

During those three days, we're going to use the Code, the Core Four, the Stack, and WARRIOR AI inside ONE PIVOT to help you confront your current reality.

Then we're going to take that clarity and build your next 12-week Impossible Game.

Not a motivational exercise.

Not another notebook full of goals.

A working game you can take into your life.

You'll identify what you're creating.

Why it matters.

The actions required.

And how you'll return, report, and recalibrate as the weeks unfold.

BECAUSE A TARGET WITHOUT EXECUTION IS JUST AN IDEA.

And I don't want you leaving WARRIORCon 6 with another idea.

I want you to leave with a game you're ready to play.

SO HERE'S YOUR PREPARATION CHALLENGE FOR TODAY.

Imagine it's twelve weeks after WARRIORCon 6.

You've followed through.

You've made the difficult decisions.

You've taken the actions.

You've confronted the patterns that used to stop you.

Now answer three questions.

1. What would need to be different in my life for me to say these twelve weeks truly mattered?

2. What result would make me proud of the man I became while pursuing it?

3. Who else would benefit if I actually created that result?

Don't worry about making the target perfect.

We'll do that work together.

For now, I simply want you beginning to see what's possible.

Because the future you're imagining doesn't have to remain an idea.

It can become a target.

The target can become a game.

And the game can become a new reality.

Brother, twelve weeks will pass whether you choose to play or not.

THE QUESTION ISN'T WHETHER THE NEXT 84 DAYS WILL HAPPEN.

THE QUESTION IS WHAT YOU'LL BUILD WITH THEM.

I'm looking forward to putting this into your hands.

14 years to build it.

Three days to put it in your hands.

Garrett J. White
Founder, Wake Up Warrior
Creator, ONE PIVOT & WARRIOR AI

P.S. WARRIORCon 6 is December 2–4, 9 AM–6 PM Eastern each day. This is a virtual, hands-on working experience. Protect your calendar, prepare a quiet workspace, and make sure you have access to WARRIOR AI inside ONE PIVOT.
